claims.text: Many reviewers report the product effectively controls excessive sweating, often after other products failed.
Several long-term users say they can apply it less frequently over time, with some going days or weeks between applications.
Some reviewers experienced skin irritation, burning, or itching, though some still consider it worth it.
A few reviewers found it ineffective or only partially effective, particularly for hands.
Reviewers emphasize that following the directions is important for it to work.
